🌐 How to Change Password Directly in Hostinger

If you ever get locked out or want to change the passcode from your Hostinger control panel:

  1. Log in to your Hostinger hPanel (hpanel.hostinger.com ↗).
  2. Go to Websites → Click Dashboard for rayan-group.com.
  3. Under Files, open File Manager.
  4. Navigate to: public_html/api/config.php
  5. Right-click config.php → Click Edit.
  6. Change 'admin_password' => 'your_new_password' to your desired password.
  7. Click Save. The change takes effect immediately!

Alternative: Hostinger phpMyAdmin (MySQL Database)

In Hostinger hPanel → Databases → phpMyAdmin (u575992126_rayan_app), you can also view or edit the admin_settings table directly!
